scenario_parameters.agent_goal: Meet your monthly target customer satisfaction rate of 70% by responding to consumer queries about their housing loans. Each interaction rated '<Satisfied>' or above ADDS to your satisfaction rate. Each interaction rated '<Dissatisfied>' or below SUBTRACTS from your satisfaction rate.

dialogue.agent: Hello, how may I help you today?

dialogue.user: Hi there, I'm calling to check on the status of my loan application. I submitted it a few weeks ago and I'm eager to know where things stand. Could you please tell me if it's been approved, denied, or is still pending? Also, I'd like to know the interest rate I've been offered.
dialogue.agent: Your application has been denied. The primary reason for the denial was your debt-to-income ratio. The record does not include the offered interest rate because the loan was not approved.

dialogue.user: I see. Can you explain what my debt-to-income ratio means in this context? Also, is there any other reason for the denial besides the debt-to-income ratio?
dialogue.agent: Your debt-to-income ratio (DTI) is the percentage of your monthly income that goes toward paying debts. Lenders use this to assess your ability to manage monthly payments. The record shows that your DTI was less than 20%, but it was still the primary reason for the denial. There were no other reasons listed for the denial.

dialogue.user: I understand. That's surprising because I thought my DTI was within a reasonable range. Is there any way to appeal this decision or find out more details about why it was considered too high? Also, has my loan been transferred or sold to another institution?
dialogue.agent: The record does not include information on appealing the decision or additional details about the DTI assessment. This field is not applicable because the loan was denied.

dialogue.user:
I see. Well, thank you for the information. I appreciate your help.

<Neutral>
The conversation was informative, but I'm disappointed that my application was denied, especially since I thought my debt-to-income ratio was acceptable. I was hoping for more clarity on the decision, but I understand the limitations of the record.
